subject.title: message-tool send mid-turn writes 'delivery-mirror' side-branch into transcript → permanent HTTP 400 loop, session silently dead

question: Should this mixed report remain the coordination issue for both the delivery-mirror side-branch poison and the empty signed Anthropic thinking replay poison, or should maintainers split it across the narrower open issue and PR paths?
rationale: The report combines separate session-replay paths with open candidate PRs, and choosing the canonical tracking shape plus final Anthropic replay policy is a maintainer coordination decision rather than a safe new repair job.

options.title: Coordinate Existing Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror side-append PR and the Anthropic replay PR, then close only when both failure classes have current-main proof.

options.title: Split Tracking
options.body: Move the thinking-signature half to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92201 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and keep this issue focused on delivery-mirror side branches.

options.title: Wait For Reporter Fixture
options.body: Ask for sanitized JSONL/log excerpts before deciding whether the delivery-mirror half still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Existing Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror side-append PR and the Anthropic replay PR, then close only when both failure classes have current-main proof.
